specification.note: PROVISIONAL: the encoding is not reviewed or accepted; an unmatched action may reflect the encoding rather than the build

rule.text: Actions: at the start of each turn a player gets one move action per own piece still on the board. The only way to get more is a "+1 action" effect. An action moves one piece, or a whole stack of own pieces, one square up, down, left or right.

rule.text: Fairness: an effect does exactly the same thing to whichever piece enters it, whoever owns the effect and whoever owns the piece. Directions are absolute (north, south, east, west) or relative to how the piece entered (back, forward).

rule.text: Burn on entry: an effect cell fires when a piece arrives on it and is then used up (the cell becomes empty). This holds however the piece arrived: by its own move, or by being moved there by another effect. Only that cell is used up; the effect's other cells stay.

rule.text: Shield: the piece gets a shield. A shielded piece ignores the next effect cell it enters (the effect does not apply to it); that uses up the shield, and the cell is used up as usual.
